summary: Baseline first: the solution builds (0 warnings), the repro failed with its 2 recorded FAILs, and the 9 fixture cases were green. I kept the engine-appended fitness entries and the untracked repro, and edited only the entries. PoolWatch.ps1 now judges a guard-stopped arm before the interrupted branch and words the interrupt from the marks that exist. Get-Net's table is Ordinal, and the 14 new tags are recorded; the seven WC leak tags were already in the list. PoolWatchCases got guard-and-interrupt fixtures, P-004 and a scratch root that survives the engine's TEMP. I added the outcome-C record with its 17-row disposition table, spike 107's three runs, a class corpus for the case-folding rule with 7 plant rows, and four tests under tests/bugs. The repro exits 0 under pwsh 7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1; every test, the harness (124 rows as recorded) and the C-052 rehearsal pass; every mutation I ran goes red. No change under src/.

deviations: PoolWatchCases: Invoke-Report and Invoke-Fixture now echo through Write-Host instead of Write-Output. Their Write-Output was part of the functions' return values, so no -Report text ever reached a case's output and no earlier check could compare it. The 0feac0e comparison (N1) needed it. Checks and results are unchanged.

The fitness entry has three patterns beyond the design's four: operands the other way round, Group-Object, and Select/Sort -Unique on a tag. Plants S44-S50 and a 58-row corpus were added. O-018 asks for the class to be closed, and 'NtfF' -eq $_.tag and Group-Object tag fold case and were missed.

P-003's guard arms are two extra fixtures after the unchanged first one, not arms inside it. This keeps the old fixture's output identical to 0feac0e. Three shapes beyond the design's (b)-(e) were added: not interrupted with /settled missing, null /exit tags, and a null /exit system120089 on an interrupted arm.

Four runnable tests were added under tests/bugs, one per obligation family, because the obligations need a command for each (SL-099-ReportTextUnchanged, -TagCompareRuleCorpus, -CasesUnderEngineTemp, -RecordAndEvidence). The design named the checks but no files.

The comparison test copies the tree's PoolWatchCases.ps1 over the base copy's before running both. The base copy has no Get-ScratchParent and prints no -Report text, so this is the only way the same fixtures read through the two PoolWatch.ps1 scripts.
All seven WC leak tags were already in the watched list at 0feac0e, so only the 14 other names were appended. The design said to append the leak tags if absent.

Spike-107 evidence is the whole run folders (53 files, 4.2 MB) minus output.txt and 0-byte files, not marks.jsonl filtered to the tags the spike recorded. Those marks only hold the spike's tags already.
The net-unread wording carries its reason: 'its net at the stop is unread (no X2/exit mark)', where 0feac0e printed no reason. No existing fixture pins it.
The repro was not committed: I may not touch version control. It stays untracked and unchanged in tests/bugs.
not_built: Committing the repro (SC-130 acceptance test): version control is the merge's, so the file stays untracked and unchanged.

Everything the design assigns to the measurement-preparation slice and the two person-run sessions: the -Report reader for Ntff, WCse, WCss, WCfn and the new tags; Y3; the Q-185 dir arm; a guard-trip rehearsal through Invoke-ExeArm; R3-1, R4-1, X5, N1, the cancel trigger's calibration; Sandbox protocols fitting 1,800 s; session 1 and session 2. All are carried in the record's table and in follow_ups.
A -Rehearse extension and C-052 changes: the design marks that case non-material; C-052 was only run once, unchanged, to see the shipped path.
follow_ups: Session 1 (a person): PoolWatch.ps1 -Prepare, a true Start > Restart, -Protocol within 30 minutes; commit the logs under docs/design/SL-095-runs/ (Q-184), including the /settled reading for any guard-stopped arm, and read them with docs/design/SL-099-outcome-c-redesign.md (d).
Session 2 (a person) for DONE (c) under Q-178, Q-184 and Q-185: a second true Restart, the same idle, dir /a /s per sibling root of C: skipping the Layers store.

Measurement-preparation slice, before session 1: a -Report reader for Ntff, WCse, WCss, WCfn and the 14 new tags; Y3 (the closing layer control); the session-2 dir arm; a guard-trip rehearsal through Invoke-ExeArm; R3-1, R4-1, X5, N1; the cancel trigger's calibration; Sandbox protocols that fit the 1,800 s ceiling; and a PoolWatch.ps1:654-655 rehearsal route through Get-ScratchParent if C-052 must pass under the engine's TEMP.
